Nina Gomez: quick FYI 12: we rolled pavo-mini@v1-int4-ptq into shadow and redteam JB_PASS spiked from 9% -> 38% after switching to activation-folded kernels + system-msg caching disabled
Rajiv Kapoor: wait activation folding + cache off? why was cache disabled?
Nina Gomez: memory budget on the 16GB inference tier forced us to disable persistent sys-msg caching for that pool (evict-on-epoch)
